literal: Those who are called Antanar are virtuous people, indeed, because of conducting themselves having assumed righteous compassion towards every living being.
translation: They are called the truly virtuous who show righteous compassion to every living being and conduct their lives accordingly.
modern: எல்லா உயிர்களிடத்தும் செம்மையான கருணையை மேற்கொண்டு வாழ்வதால், அறவோர்களே அந்தணர் என்று சொல்லப்படுபவர் ஆவர்.
explanation: In this couplet, the poet defines true nobility and virtue based purely on ethical conduct and universal compassion. The key word 'sentanmai' combines righteousness and coolness, representing a gentle, loving-kindness. The poet asserts that true virtue belongs to those who assume this compassion and live by it toward all living creatures without exception. Thus, spiritual stature is defined not by birth or ritual, but by the active practice of benevolence.
